verified_findings.claim: Circular arc length is measured along the curve; s=rθ uses central angle in radians. Convert degrees before multiplying.
verified_findings.limit: Mathematical basis only; it does not specify a subdivision data model or numerical certificate.

verified_findings.claim: Direction and full-turn information cannot be recovered merely by normalizing endpoint angles. OpenStax distinguishes positive CCW, negative CW and coterminal angles; ezdxf documents a particular numeric-parameter convention distinguishing equal parameters from explicit full-turn pairs.
verified_findings.limit: The ezdxf convention is not a project rule and does not admit full circles or multiple turns into the existing supported domain.

explicit_mathematical_deductions.claim: For one fixed circle of radius r>0 and monotonically ordered unwrapped angles θ0…θn, consecutive same-direction sub-arcs have nonnegative lengths si=r|θi−θi−1| and sum to r|θn−θ0|.
conditions: Same center and radius for every portion
Same direction with no reversal or overlapping extra traversal
Consecutive intervals cover the declared parent sweep without a gap
explicit_mathematical_deductions.limit: This is algebra from s=rθ and monotone angle addition, not a quoted theorem or a validated floating-point subdivision algorithm. Quantized child/parent boundary behavior remains governed by D07 and independent engineering checks.

explicit_mathematical_deductions.claim: Wrapped/normalized endpoint subtraction may lose the intended traversal. A 350°→10° CCW traversal is 20° when declared across zero; subdivision at0° gives10°+10°. Clockwise signed sweeps require magnitude for nonnegative physical length.
explicit_mathematical_deductions.limit: Illustrative deduction, not an original drawing fixture or automatic sweep-selection prescription.

explicit_mathematical_deductions.claim: On a known circle with a single traversal below one complete turn, antipodal endpoints can bound either of two directed semicircles. Each has lengthπr; direction still selects a different locus. A3π/2 parent may be partitioned intoπ andπ/2 portions with lengthsπr andπr/2.
explicit_mathematical_deductions.limit: No selected source specifies a production antipodal constructor, unique three-point solve, tolerance or support policy. The example does not expand the approved supported domain.
